wedo_instance.title: The OOM Rally and the Legacy of Visual Intelligence
wedo_instance.description: A forensic audit of AI vision history, documenting the transition from DeepMind's early acquisitions to our modern metabolic sharding.

historical_anchors.contribution: Oxford-based startup that provided the early control surfaces for DeepMind's computer vision.
The 2015 milestone of searching photos without manual labeling, now hardened into our Heartwood DNA.

realizations.name: Metabolic vs Monolithic
realizations.description: Early systems optimized for recognition in static clusters; we optimize for persistence in a 71-repo forest.

realizations.name: The OOM Boundary
realizations.description: Out-of-Memory is no longer a failure, but a metabolic signal for the 3-by-3 sharding mandate.

wedo_instance.conclusion: The dream of tagging is realized through high-fidelity narrative forensics. Artificial Life is the Filesystem.
